messages:
Eddie CS: Heads up — Caldera QBR on Thu. We got a large embedding surge Monday night that paused an experiment. Need a cost rundown + enablement.
Sam FinOps: paste 30d totals and spike window and I'll run run-rate vs surge sims.
Eddie CS: 30d totals: gen 820k tokens, emb 2.1M tokens. Spike (2025-12-08 01:10-01:50 UTC) +1.9M embeddings. Est pre-spike spend ~$1.6k/mo.
Tara SE: sounds like a runaway ingestion loop. I can model 2 scenarios: burst only and burst + prefix cache + batching.
Sam FinOps: quick note: with embeddings-heavy plan, unit cost multiplier matters. Rough sim: 3x embeddings => add ~$5.8k/mo. Will draft conservative retainer ask.
Eddie CS: customer quote: "unexpected bill forced pause" — flagging renewal risk. Recommend enablement + one-page config to remediate.
Tara SE: demo offer: 30m focused session on batching, KV prefix cache, and fallbacks. Tue 11am PT available.
Lin Docs: I'll prepare a one-pager template and a short checklist for validating quantized-model parity (they reported quality variance when switching).
billing-bot: alert: account Caldera exceeded 68% of monthly-retainer at 2025-12-08T02:05:10Z
Eddie CS: include the bot alert in the QBR as the trigger for buffer ask. Proposed QBR slides: 1) baseline vs surge 2) recommended retainer + 7-day safety credits 3) enablement slot + recording 4) one-pager config + checklist 5) follow-up plan for output variance.
Sam FinOps: I'll attach a simple table (baseline/burst/buffer) and a recommended ask band by Wed EOD.
Tara SE: I'll put together latency/cost deltas and a 90-second demo clip for the QBR appendix.
Lin Docs: drafting template now; will include code snippets and rollback steps.
Eddie CS: assigning actions: Sam - cost table & retainer bands; Tara - demo + tech appendix; Lin - template & checklist; Eddie - QBR facilitation & customer note. Thanks all. :rocket:
